name: Worktrees + tmux
summary: Run several coding agents at once, each in its own git worktree so their edits never collide, and watch them side by side in tmux panes. It needs no framework: git and a terminal multiplexer do the isolation and the layout. You review and merge each branch yourself.
facts: git worktree, tmux, any CLI coding agent
Separate checkout per agent; shared git history
Simple and transparent, but merging and conflicts are on you
how: Create a git worktree per task, each on its own branch
Open a tmux window or pane per worktree
Start a coding agent in each pane with its task
Review each branch's diff and merge or discard it
goodFor: Several independent coding tasks in one repo
Comparing attempts at the same task
watchOut: Each worktree needs its own dependencies and ports
Merge conflicts when tasks touch the same files
